PASCUAL Bataan Province Balanga City, Bataan Dear Vice Gov. Pascual: DILG Opinion No. 12 OCAL L QECO>OS RELEASED SIGNATU2E'. DATE: TIME'. CONTROL ÆüßL3 This pertains to your letter seeking this Department's legal opinion on the possible administrative offenses that Gov. Garcia may have committed in all the three instances as provided in your letter. You also requested this Department to confirm as to the lack of or delay in the filing of application for leave of absence of Governor Garcia in all three (3) cases as enumerated below to wit: I) Gov. Enrique T. Garcia, Jr. went on a sick leave from December 19, 2011 up to January 12, 2012. Accordingly, information regarding his leave of absence reached in your knowledge on January 19, 2012, only after you inquired in writing with the Office of the Provincial administrator. 2) Gov. Garcia went on leave for several weeks in the first quarter of 2011 to undergo a medical procedure. Per your letter no office was notified of his absence and it was also not clear if he filed an application for leave of absence. You were only informed by the Office of the Provincial Administrator after you inquired in writing and after Gov. Garcia allegedly started to report back to work. 3) On November 03 to November 15, 2011, Gov. Garcia left for abroad without informing your office or any department or office in the provincial government of Bataan. Again Gov. Garcia did not file an application for leave of absence. You were only able to assume as Acting Governor, midway of his leave of absence and only after you were able to confirm his departure for abroad from the Bureau of Immigration and Deportation (BID). In reply thereto, we regret to inform you that we cannot render an opinion on the matter due to the fact that this Department is constituted as the 'investigating authority with regard to cases filed against Provincial and City Elected officials before the Office of the President. Hence, giving you guidance on the possible administrative offenses to be filed against Gov. Garcia will create a conflict with the mandate of this Department. With regard to your request for confirmation regarding the delayed/late filing of application for leave of absence of Gov. Garcia, please be informed that we cannot act on the matter since it is beyond the ambit of power of this Department. However, for your guidance, may we invite your attention to Section 47(a)(i)(b) of the Local Government Code which provides and we quote:

-2- "Section 47. Approval of Leaves of Absence. — (a) Leaves of absence of local elective officials shall be approved as follows: (I) Leaves of absence of the governor and the mayor of a highly urbanized city or an independent component city shall be approved by the President or his duly authorized representative; xxx xxx xxx (b) Whenever the application for leave of absence hereinabove specified is not acted upon within five (5) working days after receipt thereof, the application for leave of absence shall be deemed approved." For your information. LS:94/11 Very truly yours, JESUSB OQ IV Director III &EIVED EFkn Dat
